|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Jakku: Starship Graveyard (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-L-jakkustarshipgraveyard-2022-06-01.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-L-jakkustarshipgraveyard-2022-06-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-jakkustarshipgraveyard-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V4-L-jakkustarshipgraveyard-2022-06-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-jakkustarshipgraveyard-2022-06-01.gif]], 1 June 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-jakkustarshipgraveyae8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkustarshipgraveyard.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkustarshipgraveyard.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
